hero.title: TechnoAi Achieves Diamond Local Content Partner Certification from Etihad Aviation Group

blocks.html: TechnoAi FZE LLC has been officially recognized by Etihad Aviation Group as a Diamond Local Content Partner, demonstrating our commitment to supporting the UAE's national economic vision through local capability, innovation, and strategic partnerships.

We are proud to announce that TechnoAi FZE LLC – Abu Dhabi has been awarded the Diamond Local Content Partner Certification by Etihad Aviation Group under the Al Watani – Etihad’s National Partners program.

This certification recognizes organizations that demonstrate a strong commitment to local content development, national value creation, and support for the UAE’s long-term economic growth objectives. Achieving the Diamond level reflects TechnoAi’s continued dedication to delivering advanced technology solutions while contributing to the development of local capabilities and strategic partnerships across the region.

As a technology provider specializing in AI, robotics, autonomous systems, satellite communications, industrial automation, and mission-critical solutions, TechnoAi remains committed to supporting organizations with innovative technologies that create sustainable value for both industry and the national economy.

We extend our sincere appreciation to Etihad Aviation Group for this recognition and look forward to strengthening our collaboration in support of the UAE’s vision for innovation, localization, and industrial excellence.
